items.title: ‘Ahead of his time’: AI helps unlock discoveries hidden in notebooks of man who transformed maths
items.summary: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written text – much of it in an obsolete shorthand – which is now said to contain hundreds of proved theorems The Austrian logician Kurt Gödel was one of the most original thinkers of the 20th century.
